evidence_type: Assistant visual transcription of the learner-supplied DBeaver aggregate screenshot; both rows and all twelve field positions, including both complete PASS values, are visible. No direct learner-database read.
comparison_scope: FINAL_HOLDOUT d1914-d1941, 2016-04-25 through 2016-05-22, with training ending at d1913, 2016-04-24. All 30490 product-store series and 853720 daily positions per model remain included.
display_normalization: Remove displayed thousands separators from counts and totals. Preserve counts and actual_units as JSON integers; normalize predicted_units to two-decimal strings and mae, mean_error and macro_rmsse to six-decimal strings, restoring displayed -0.10618 to -0.106180. Preserve origin/model/status text and the SNAIVE7 then WEEKDAY4 row order. NULL would remain JSON null.
fingerprint_method: SHA256 of UTF-8 compact JSON for the ordered normalized results, with sorted object keys, ensure_ascii=False and comma/colon separators without added spaces. Integer counts/actual totals, two-decimal prediction strings and six-decimal metric strings match the frozen preflight report contract.

derived_interpretation.percentage_basis: Estimates calculated from the displayed six-decimal metrics. Existing preserved evidence does not retain the unrounded independent aggregate values; no forecasts or final-target calculations were rerun to obtain percentages.
derived_interpretation.underprediction_total_basis: Exact arithmetic on the accepted aggregate actual and two-decimal predicted totals; these total shortfalls are not lost-sales or stockout estimates.

scope: The screenshot accepts all twenty-four aggregate field values and their canonical report hash; it does not independently establish underlying row-level calculations or learner conceptual understanding. Complete source/history/mapping checks, 6829760 saved candidates, 853720 final targets, 1707440 final error records, 60980 diagnostics, high-precision numeric checks, preserved development fingerprints, seven fixture families and fourteen subcases, input/source preservation and private-file cleanup remain separate historical assistant preflight evidence. WEEKDAY4 was selected globally before final evaluation and SNAIVE7 remains its fixed reference. Lower final-period MAE and macro RMSSE plus smaller absolute aggregate bias support this frozen baseline choice for this one period; they do not imply improvement for every series or date, statistical significance, an accuracy percentage, future guarantee, inventory or financial benefit. The now-exposed period cannot serve as a fresh test for a future tree model. This completes learner reproduction of the baseline final evaluation only, not the full portfolio project.
